jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Working for Open Cosmos

Aim high, go beyond!

At Open Cosmos we are solving the world’s biggest challenges from space, providing businesses, governments and researchers access to more readily available information than ever before - ready for the challenge? Then read on…

Working in the Ground Segment Team

Our team is responsible for all ground-side software which gathers and disseminates data from existing & future satellite fleets to our customers. We follow a highly agile methodology, we look for suggestions & contributions from all team members, and we’re not afraid to try new ways of working when we see an opportunity for improvement. Our data engineer will work highly-collaboratively alongside software engineers, taking responsibility for a variety of data critical to our and our customers’ commercial success.

What will you be doing?

At Open Cosmos our goal is to offer, through our platform EO (Earth observation) data, IoT data, and other data types with both temporal and... spatial components.

For these data sources, you’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining ingestion/processing pipelines, company standards for these data and associated metadata, monitoring the health of these data/pipelines and ensuring their conformance to these standards.

You’ll find solutions which balance what data products our customers find most convenient with what fits best in the framework/technical-detail of our systems (or propose architectural changes to improve how we manage data).

There will be lots of continuous learning as new shapes of data need to be brought into the platform, requiring processing techniques not yet implemented in our workflows.

What you need to be successful

We’re more interested in what you can do than being dogmatic about your background! We’d love to take a look at your CV even if you’re not sure you tick all the boxes.

Should Haves
• Most processing involves scripting/programming/working on the command line, so you’ll need to have some familiarity of how to use these
• Love for neat data - defining conventions and standards, ensuring items adhere to them
• End-User-Needs focus for how data are processed, presented and made available
• Ability to work & learn independently, and communicate effectively with the rest of the team to overcome blocking issues together

Nice to Haves
• Can administrate data via (REST) APIs or in databases (Postgres in particular)
• Knowledge of satellite imagery/data sources and how to process them

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
En IT Partner, estamos buscando dos talentosos Data Engineers con 5 años de experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo en Madrid. Esta es una oportunidad emocionante para formar parte de proyectos innovadores y trabajar en un ambiente colaborativo y dinámico.
• Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de datos eficientes.
• Desarrollar soluciones utilizando Python con enfoque funcional para manejo de datos.
• Experiencia sólida en bases de datos relacionales y SQL.
• Creación y mantenimiento de pipelines de datos utilizando REST y SOAP APIs.
• Experiencia en control de versiones utilizando Git y CI/CD con enfoque multi-rama.

Ofrecemos:
• Salario competitivo acorde a experiencia y habilidades.
• Ambiente de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y formación continua.
• Trabajar en proyectos innovadores y desafiantes junto a un equipo experimentado.

¡Si buscas un nuevo reto profesional donde puedas desarrollar tus habilidades como Data Engineer, esta es tu... oportunidad! ¡Envía tu CV ahora y únete a IT Partner para hacer un impacto significativo en el mundo de la tecnología!

Requisitos:

Requisitos Deseables:
• Exposición a DBT será altamente valorada.
• Conocimientos en Spark.
• Familiaridad con tecnologías de data streaming.
• Comprensión sólida de Arquitectura y Modelado de Datos: Debes tener un sólido entendimiento de cómo diseñar y estructurar arquitecturas de datos eficientes.
• Programación en Python para Datos (Enfoque Funcional): Experiencia en el desarrollo de soluciones utilizando Python con un enfoque funcional para el manejo de datos.
• Experiencia en Bases de Datos Relacionales y SQL: Debes tener experiencia previa trabajando con bases de datos relacionales y un dominio sólido de SQL.
• Exposición previa a APIs REST y SOAP (para Pipelines de Datos / ETL): Experiencia previa en el desarrollo y mantenimiento de pipelines de datos utilizando tanto APIs REST como SOAP.
• Git & CI/CD (Enfoque de Ramas Múltiples): Experiencia en control de versiones utilizando Git y prácticas de integración y entrega continua (CI/CD) con un enfoque de múltiples ramas.

Ubicación: Madrid (3 días presenciales, 2 remoto)

Experiencia Requerida: 5 años

Nivel de Inglés Requerido: C1

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We Are Denim Heads.

We love denim. Live and breathe it. It’s in our DNA. At G-Star, we see no limit to what denim can do. We believe it can be force of progress and innovation for both people and planet. How? By hiring the most creative, curious and caring minds. People who think beyond fashion. Bringing big ideas to big challenges. Driven by possibility. Those who work hard, make mistakes, but always continue to grow.

Denim is in our DNA, our people are our stitching.

Join the denim heads making raw denim.

Here's what we'll do together:

As Data Engineer, you are responsible for the G-Star global data lake in GCP. The data lake covers many business aspects within G-Star and has consumer, digital, retail and wholesale data. Your main tasks will be to build data integrations into GBQ, design and develop datasets. Next to that, it would be a plus if you pro-actively see options to improve data quality and optimize on cloud cost. You will be part of the global Data and Analytics... team, the team consists of Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Data Analysts.

Duties & Responsibilities:
• Design and build data systems and pipelines
• Developing and maintaining datasets
• Analyze and organize raw data
• Design self-service datasets
• Drive the further professionalization of G-Star’s data and cloud landscape
• Explore ways to improve data quality and reliability
• Optimize cost and efficiency of storages, orchestration and queries

Here's what you bring to the table:
• Degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar field; a Master’s is a plus
• Technical expertise with data models, data mining, data warehousing and segmentation techniques
• Knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Python)
• Hands-on experience with Google Big Query
• Great numerical and analytical skills
• Data engineering certification (e.g Google Data Engineer) is a plus
• You are flexible and adapt your work schedule and prioritization to best serve the business needs
• Good communication skills

Here’s what we bring to the table:

Beyond a competitive salary, working at G-Star brings many other perks and exciting opportunities: an awesome and diverse team that collaborates to change the game; a work environment that offers room for fun, inspiration and innovation; a clothing budget; a healthy lunch, and last but not least, a discount on a new bicycle.

At G-Star RAW, we embrace diversity and value the power of data in shaping the future of our fashion brand. As a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in driving our business forward and revolutionizing the way we use data. If you are ready to make your mark in the world of retail analytics, apply now and join us in our Valencia hub.

What will happen next:

During this job application, we will ask you to play a couple of short neuroscientific games. These games provide you with the opportunity to showcase your potential, talents, and personality. As a result, we can ensure equal opportunities for everyone who applies, by evaluating everyone based on objective, scientifically proven insights rather than gut feeling.

As we value personal growth and transparency, we will make sure you receive your results on the games as well. Good luck

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer Intern
jobs_results.description:
Data Engineer Intern

Eurovision Services is looking for a Data Engineer Intern based in Madrid, Spain.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THIS POSITION

In this role as Data Engineer Intern, you will:
• Support on the design and implement data warehousing solutions using star schema / snowflake model.
• Support in the develop and maintenance of data pipelines using Azure Data Factory
• Support in the develop and maintenance of reports using Power BI, SSRS, and SSAS
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement data-driven solutions.
• Collaborate in the administration of database, especially for Oracle and MySQL DBs

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• The successful candidate must have:
• Possibility to sign an internship agreement with your university or business school.
• Availability to work full time.
• Proficiency in English is a must.
• Passion for learning, adaptability to change and grow.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field... Master’s degree is a plus.
• Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and methodologies is a plus.

BENEFITS AND PERKS
• Hybrid modality: 2 days in the office and 3 days remote.
• Full-time job with flexible starting hour.
• Remuneration of 900€ monthly
• Ticket restaurant:11€ per working day

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
DATAIS, a consultancy specializing in the design and execution of data and artificial intelligence projects, adopts an integrated approach to cover the entire data cycle and strategy. As a network of expert professionals, DATAIS fosters trust and collaborates to provide data and IA solutions, and tailored support services, including training and consulting.

Born as a Spin-off of VISUALITICS focused on data analysis and visualization expertise, our projects have expanded to engage with diverse aspects of the data landscape.

We want to empower our clients with a competitive advantage by unlocking true value and creating meaningful, actionable and timely business insights with our ability to use state-of-the-art technologies and algorithms. We develop the strategic, technical, and human capabilities that take companies from vision to value and create truly data-driven organizations.

We are now looking for Data Engineers (3+ years of experience) to join our team based in Madrid. Would... you like to work in a young and friendly environment? If you love technology, challenges and willing to contribute to our mission…then you could be the person we are looking for!

Tareas

As a Data Engineer you will:
• Design and implementation of solutions processing large and unstructured datasets (Data Lake Architecture, Streaming Architecture)
• Design, build and maintain big data architecture and data pipeline
• Develop and implement CI/CD pipeline automation solutions.
• Implementation, optimization and testing of modern DWH/Big Data solutions based on Azure cloud, GCP or AWS platform and Continuous Delivery / Continuous Integration environment
• Data processing efficiency improvement, migrations from on-prem to public cloud platforms.
• Build relationships with client stakeholders to establish a high level of rapport and confidence
• Work with clients and teams to deliver modern data products
• You are a very creative person, who drives to build your own prototype solutions and provides training and guidance to team members and partners.

Requisitos

Qualifications & Compentences:

3+ years of experience in Data Engineering field
• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other scientific fields
• Data Enthusiast: Driven by a passion for data and technology.
• ETL Maestro: Skilled in orchestrating ETL processes with precision and finesse.
• Spark Wizard: Adept at conjuring data cleaning and transformation magic in a Spark/Scala environment using Python.
• SQL Sage: Master of SQL and the Apache Spark realm.
• OLAP Explorer: Navigates OLAP architectures with ease.
• Cloud Commander: Technically savvy in architecting and managing cloud-based solutions.
• DevOps and Kubernetes explorer: Loves working collaboratively and follows best practices in Git and DevOps and best practices Steers the ship of Kubernetes even if you're just starting out.
• Data Alchemist: Comfortable with schema-on-read databases like Redis.
• Meticulous Organizer: Possesses an eye for detail and organizational finesse.
• Independent Trailblazer: Thrives when working proactively and autonomously.
• Problem-Solving Maestro: Solves challenges through information gathering, thoughtful evaluation, and ingenious solutions.
• Greate communicator, both verbal and written
• Pressure Player: Thrives under pressure, even within complex organizational landscapes.
• English Pro: Proficiency in English is non-negotiable.r data and technology

Beneficios

What do we offer:
• Competitive salary
• Semi-annual bonus on target achievement
• Flexible Benefits
• Remote or Hybrid work
• Flexible working hours
• Wellness days
• Friendly and challenging working environment
• Lifelong learning mindset with budget for certifications, training and personal development
• Be protagonist of disruptive tech events in collaboration with several tech communities, scaleups, Universities and Bootcamps

Become a part of our community on LinkedIn to discover more about our activities and stay updated on all the latest news in machine learning, big data, and AI. Join Datais People on meetup .com/es-ES/datais/ to receive updates on our upcoming events

jobs_results.title: Data Engineer Trainee
jobs_results.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer Trainee in Madrid, who is willing to join a fresh, agile, entrepreneur environment. The ideal candidate would be pursuing a Computer Science Degree or training in Data Engineering tasks. Recently graduated applicants would also be considered.

The candidate should have problem-solving mindset, with a strong hands-on attitude who is looking to execute day to day tasks to support the different clients and project.

The candidate would like to work in an exciting and flexible environment, focusing on performance, using the latest technologies. This role is based in Madrid.

What you will do

Support the Data Engineering team to complete the migration of existing data pipelines due to a change in data model and format for a large number of datasets.
• ETL configurations in order to ingest new DDM datasets into our platform
• root cause for ETL issues and apply appropriate corrections
• quality control
• to improve technical... documentation
• implement and maintain data integration code based on Python and PySpark where required.
• a wide range of data-driven projects working on assigned projects to meet client project requirements and deadlines.

Your qualifications

The following software engineering familiarizations are desirable
• Technologies: JSON, Python.
• Architecture: Cloud (MS Azure preferred), Azure Data Factory and Databricks.
• Platforms: Understanding the Azure service catalog
• Databases: Knowledge with SQL Server, PostgreSQL and/or Snowflake is a plus.
• Others: Interest in Business Intelligence and Process Improvements.

Ideal soft skills:
• passionate, intellectual curiosity, self-starter, embracing continuous improvement, execution-oriented, change driver.
• spirit, quick learner, flexible and ability to adapt to change.
• player, highly qualified to build internal and external relationships.
• high self-motivation and ambition.
• orientated, competitive and comfortable in challenging situations
• communication and interpersonal skills
• is our working language. Spanish, French or Portuguese would be an advantage.

Life at Redslim
• work environment within a cohesive and collaborative team
• package commensurate with experience (including substantial performance bonus)
• All Staff gathering week, office parties, team offsite
• What’s Next

Redslim is constantly seeking new talents. You may already have the right skills we look for, come join us! We believe that people from different backgrounds and experiences can bring fresh ideas, thinking, and approaches that translate into effective and efficient ways of working. You're welcome at Redslim whatever your background is.

If you think this position is for you, please click the Apply Now button!

Redslim is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Redslim. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias
